test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 3rd December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

The science of surveying and charting bodies of water
solution:
The correct answer is: Hydrography

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Hydrography means the science of the measurement, description, and mapping of the surface waters of the earth.
 
• So, it is clear that 'Hydrography' can be used as a one-word substitute for '**The science of surveying and charting bodies of water**​'

Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Topography **means the physical characteristics of an area of land, especially the position of its rivers, mountains, etc.
 
• **Holography **means the study or production of holograms.
 
• **Demography **means is the statistical study of human populations. The number and characteristics of people in a particular area.
